. ( aey payghumber ! ) keh do :  meray paas wahi aai hai kay jinnaat ki aik jamat ney ( Quran ) ghor say suna , aur ( apni qoam say jaker ) kaha kay : hum ney aik ajeeb Quran suna hai ,
jo raah-e-raast ki taraf rehnumai kerta hai , iss liye hum uss per emaan ley aaye hain , aur abb apney perwerdigar kay sath kissi ko ( ibadat mein ) hergiz shareek nahi maanen gay .
aur yeh kay : humaray perwerdigar ki boht oonchi shaan hai , uss ney naa koi biwi rakhi hai , aur naa koi beta .
aur yeh kay : hum mein say beywaqoof log Allah kay baaray mein aesi baaten kehtay thay jo haqeeqat say boht door hain .
aur yeh kay : hum ney yeh samjha tha kay insan aur jinnaat Allah kay baaray mein jhooti baat nahi kahen gay .
aur yeh kay : insanon mein say kuch log jinnaat kay kuch logon  ki panah liya kertay thay , iss tarah inn logon  ney jinnaat ko aur sar par charha diya tha .
aur yeh kay : jaisa gumaan tum logon  ka tha , insanon ney bhi yehi gumaan kiya tha kay Allah kissi ko bhi marney kay baad doosri zindagi nahi dey ga .
aur yeh kay : hum ney aasman ko tatolna chaha to hum ney paya kay woh baray sakht pehray daaron aur sholon say bhara huwa hai .
aur yeh kay : hum pehlay sunn gunn lenay kay liye aasman ki kuch jagahon per jaa betha kertay thay . lekin abb jo koi sunna chahta hai , woh dekhta hai kay aik shola uss ki ghaat mein laga huwa hai ,
aur yeh kay : hamen yeh pata nahi tha kay aaya zameen walon say koi bura moamla kernay ka irada kiya gaya hai , ya unn kay perwerdigar ney unn ko raah-e-raast dikhaney ka irada farmaya hai .
aur yeh kay : hum mein kuch naik hain , aur kuch aesay nahi hain , aur hum mukhtalif tareeqon per chalay aarahey hain .
aur yeh kay : hum yeh samajh chukay hain kay naa hum zameen mein Allah ko aajiz ker-saktay hain , aur naa ( kahen aur ) bhag ker ussay bey bus ker-saktay hain .

aur yeh kay : jab hum ney hidayat ki baat sunn li to hum uss per emaan ley aaye . chunacheh jo koi apney perwerdigar per emaan ley aaye to uss ko naa kissi ghatay ka andesha hoga , aur naa kissi ziyadti ka .
aur yeh kay : hum mein say kuch to musalman hogaye hain , aur hum mein say ( abb bhi ) kuch zalim hain . chunacheh jo Islam laa-chukay hain , unhon ney hidayat ka raasta dhoond liya hai .
aur rahey woh log jo zalim hain to woh jahannum ka endhan hain .
aur ( aey payghumber ! Ehal-e-makkah say kaho kay mujh per ) yeh ( wahi bhi aai hai ) kay :  agar yeh log raastay per aa-ker seedhay hojayen to hum enhen wafir miqdaar mein paani say sairaab keren ,
takay uss kay zariye unn ko aazmayen .   aur jo koi apney perwerdigar ki yaad say mun morray ga , Allah ussay charrhtay huye azab mein piro dey ga .
aur yeh kay :  sajday to tamam tarr Allah hi ka haq hain ,   iss liye Allah kay sath kissi aur ki ibadat matt kero .
aur yeh kay :  jab Allah ka banda uss ki ibadat kernay kay liye kharra huwa to aisa maloom huwa jaisay yeh log uss per tootay parr rahey hain .
keh do kay :  mein to sirf apney perwerdigar ki ibadat kerta hun , aur uss kay sath koi shareek nahi manta .
keh do kay :  naa tumhara koi nuqsan meray ikhtiyar mein hai , aur naa koi bhalai .
keh do kay :  mujhay Allah say naa koi bacha sakta hai , aur naa mein ussay chorr ker koi panah ki jagah paasakta hun .

albatta ( jiss cheez per mujhay ikhtiyar diya gaya hai , woh ) Allah ki taraf say baat phoncha dena , aur uss kay payghamaat hain . aur jo koi Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki nafarmani keray ga , to uss kay liye jahannum ki aag hai jiss mein aesay log hamesha hamesha rahen gay .

. ( aur yeh log nafarmani kertay rahen gay ) yahan tak kay jab woh cheez unhen nazar aajaye gi jiss say unhen daraya jaraha hai to uss waqt unhen pata chal jaye ga kay kiss kay madadgaar kamzor hain , aur kon tadaad mein kam hai .
keh do kay :  mujhay maloom nahi hai kay jiss cheez say tumhen daraya jaraha hai , aaya woh nazdeek hai ya mera perwerdigar uss kay liye koi lambi mauddat muqarrar farmata hai .
wohi saray bhed janney wala hai , chunacheh woh apney bhed per kissi ko mutla nahi kerta ,
siwaye kissi payghumber kay jissay uss ney ( iss kaam kay liye ) pasand farma liya ho .   aesi soorat mein woh uss payghumber kay aagay aur peechay kuch mohafiz laga deta hai ,

takay Allah jaan ley kay unhon ney apney perwerdigar kay payghamaat phoncha diye hain , aur woh unn kay saray halaat ka ehata kiye huye hai , aur uss ney her her cheez ki poori tarah ginti ker rakhi hai .
